package.name: Forest Workshop
package.description: A portrait forest workshop game with automatically prepared resident profiles and letters, per-pair three-episode story plans, five production fields with every recipe already listed, daily deliveries from a home bulletin board, real weather by city, Jua typography, and backups carrying pictures and stories. Resident artwork is uploaded by the player; original character and persona cards are read only. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → 숲결 공방.
